requirements.description: Make LineDecoder treat all str.splitlines line boundaries as line endings instead of only \n.
Add or extend tests so the other splitlines line endings are covered.

label.evidence: httpx/_decoders.py:271 (NEWLINE_CHARS), :284 (text[-1] in NEWLINE_CHARS), :287 and :298; tests/test_decoders.py diff has no new cases for the extra line endings
label.notes: Reviewer said endswith("\n") isn't enough because splitlines accepts other line endings, and that tests probably don't cover them. The decoder now defines NEWLINE_CHARS with the full splitlines set (271) and checks the last character against it (284); a trailing_cr flag handles CR across chunks. The test diff only changes the existing CR assertion and anyio markers; no new tests for the other line endings appear in the diff.
